## CL++ VM 0.11.2

- Named construction now resolves aliases of data definitions, including imported types: `def _Wallet = Wallet.Account; _Wallet account = _Wallet {};`.
- Chained aliases and concrete/formal generic aliases retain the original type identity, field defaults, methods and field validation.
- Initializer and member completion are regression-tested for imported aliases.
- Compiler, Windows installer, VS Code extension and Zed extension manifest identify version 0.11.2.

A type alias is another name for the same type; it does not create a distinct definition. Optional and union aliases do not implicitly become data constructors.

The serialized bytecode version remains 13. Package APIs and the independent Luau compiler retain their separate scope.
